top_candidates.subject: [Clang] support for outputs along indirect edges of asm goto
top_candidates.diff_summary:
Summary: Adds Clang support for asm goto outputs on indirect edges by splitting indirect destinations when outputs are present and then emitting separate store sequences for each synthesized edge block. The codegen now creates synthetic split basic blocks for callbr indirect destinations, records per-destination extracted result values, and replays output stores at the proper insertion point; accompanying tests and documentation update the expected IR/control-flow shape.
Mechanisms: asm goto lowering / callbr code generation; critical-edge or indirect-edge splitting for output operands; per-edge output store emission and result extraction
Touched symbols: CodeGenFunction::EmitAsmStmt; EmitAsmStores; Builder.CreateCallBr; CallBrInst::getIndirectDests; CallBrInst::setIndirectDest; clang/test/CodeGen/asm-goto.c; clang/test/CodeGen/asm-goto2.c; clang/test/Modules/asm-goto.c
Risk relevance: Directly changes asm goto semantics and control-flow construction, matching the issue area involving asm goto outputs and optimizer crashes; Introduces new split blocks and extra stores, which can perturb SSA, loop canonicalization, and value-rewrite logic downstream; callbr/indirect-edge handling is sensitive to CFG shape and may expose latent bugs in SCEVExpander or loop exit rewriting
Build risk: Substantial Clang codegen change in a hot path, with new data structures and control-flow construction; Requires updated IR expectations in multiple tests, indicating observable codegen output changes; Touches language extension docs and module tests, so mismatches in generated IR are likely to surface during testing

top_candidates.diff_summary:
Summary: Enables CallBrPrepare in the standard codegen pipelines and updates machine verification and documentation to recognize inlineasm-br indirect targets as legitimate callbr-related blocks. The pass is wired into both IR-level and target-specific codegen preparation stages, and pipeline tests across multiple backends are updated to expect it. X86 asm-goto output tests are adjusted for the new critical-edge splitting and block-address-taken layout produced by the pass.
Mechanisms: pipeline integration; backend pass scheduling; machine verifier rule relaxation; asm goto lowering semantics documentation; block-address/indirect-target codegen layout changes
